purpose: Track public solver landscape and convert it into Moldflow CAE Studio benchmark targets without copying proprietary solver behavior.

legal_access_policy.direct_free: Use official public pages, manuals, papers, and open-source repositories that are legally accessible without bypassing access controls.
legal_access_policy.manual_review: Queue ambiguous, registration-only, or license-unclear material before download or ingestion.
legal_access_policy.paid_or_subscription: Use only as benchmark metadata unless the user provides authorized access.
legal_access_policy.no_go: No paywall bypass, credential sharing, DRM bypass, scraping against terms, or copying proprietary material cards/databases.

solvers.name: Autodesk Moldflow
public_claims: Plastic injection molding and compression molding simulation
Warpage, cooling channel efficiency, material selection, cycle time reduction
solvers.how_we_use_it: L10 benchmark target and terminology reference; do not claim equivalence without correlation data.

solvers.name: Moldex3D
public_claims: Flow behavior, weldline, short shot, air trap, temperature, warpage
solvers.how_we_use_it: Alternative commercial benchmark target for flow-front and defect KPI terminology.

solvers.name: SIGMASOFT Virtual Molding
public_claims: 3D simulation of flow, heat flux, and warpage
Process and mold optimization across injection molding cycles
solvers.how_we_use_it: Reference for full-mold thermal-cycle scope; useful for defining what our OpenFOAM proxy does not yet cover.

solvers.name: OpenFOAM interFoam / compressibleInterFoam
public_claims: Open numerical toolbox requiring case-specific modeling and validation
solvers.how_we_use_it: Internal proxy solver foundation; requires our own material model, boundary conditions, meshing, validation, and KPI layer.

latest_verified_proxy_run.status_note: Solver completed with returncode 0, but this is not full Moldflow-grade solidification validation.

safe_demo_defaults.reason: Avoid WLF thermo instability until a dedicated benchmark validates the coupled rheology path.

benchmark_kpis.target: Straight initial advance from gate followed by lateral spreading
benchmark_kpis.evidence_required: Time-resolved alpha field and visual frame review

benchmark_kpis.target: Mold wall region cooler than injected melt/front proxy
Compare at least one geometry/process case with authorized commercial or measured reference
